Mirror, Mirror

Copy the face in the glass before the timer runs out. If the reflection looks wrong, keep a straight face. Five misses and it gets out.

Keyboard: 1 neutral · 2 smile · 3 frown · 4 grin · 5 wink · 6 shocked

How to play

  • Setup: allow the camera, face it with light on your face, and keep your head centred. Make the six faces it asks for so it learns how you look.
  • Match the face: copy the expression in the mirror before the timer in the top right runs out. Hold it for half a second.
  • Faces: neutral, smile (gentle, lips closed), grin (big, teeth), frown, wink, shocked (wide eyes, open mouth).
  • Round 2 and 3: a television joins in. When it glows, copy the television and ignore the mirror.
  • Wrong reflection: if the mirror looks off (flipped, tinted, stretched, twitching, ghosted), keep a straight face until the timer ends. Copying it counts as a miss.
  • Misses: each one cracks the mirror and darkens the room. Five and it gets out.
  • Distractions: bugs, a flooding sink, footsteps, knocking and a scream will try to break your focus. Keep your eyes on the glass.
  • Win: get through all three rounds. Each round is faster than the last.
  • Stuck? The panel at bottom right shows what the game thinks your face is. The ▶ marks the face you need.
